\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 217-219 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R222-first-pass-words-from-chapters-217-219}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a university and a mistake.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a necklace, earrings, a market quarter, a harbour, a well
  \item a spider, a buffalo, a she-goat, fog, dew
  \item a rate, income, trade, a shopkeeper, a customer
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A necklace? (\textbf{\mr{हार}}, \emph{hār}.) Earrings? (\textbf{\mr{कानातले}}, \emph{kānātle}.) A market quarter? (\textbf{\mr{बाजारपेठ}}, \emph{bājārpeṭh}.) A harbour? (\textbf{\mr{बंदर}}, \emph{bandar}.) A well? (\textbf{\mr{विहीर}}, \emph{vihīr}.) A spider? (\textbf{\mr{कोळी}}, \emph{koḷī}.) A buffalo? (\textbf{\mr{म्हैस}}, \emph{mhais}.) A she-goat? (\textbf{\mr{बकरी}}, \emph{bakrī}.) Fog? (\textbf{\mr{धुके}}, \emph{dhuke}.) Dew? (\textbf{\mr{दव}}, \emph{dav}.) A rate? (\textbf{\mr{दर}}, \emph{dar}.) Income? (\textbf{\mr{उत्पन्न}}, \emph{utpanna}.) Trade? (\textbf{\mr{व्यापार}}, \emph{vyāpār}.) A shopkeeper? (\textbf{\mr{दुकानदार}}, \emph{dukāndār}.) A customer? (\textbf{\mr{ग्राहक}}, \emph{grāhak}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 220-222 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R222-second-pass-words-from-chapters-220-222}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a heel and an eyelid; eyelashes.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a heel, an eyelid; eyelashes, an eyebrow, sweat, a tear
  \item a report, a subject, chalk, marks; a quality, a cradle
  \item a career, a monthly magazine, a dictionary, a university, a mistake
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A heel? (\textbf{\mr{टाच}}, \emph{ṭāc}.) An eyelid; eyelashes? (\textbf{\mr{पापणी}}, \emph{pāpṇī}.) An eyebrow? (\textbf{\mr{भुवई}}, \emph{bhuvaī}.) Sweat? (\textbf{\mr{घाम}}, \emph{ghām}.) A tear? (\textbf{\mr{अश्रू}}, \emph{aśrū}.) A report? (\textbf{\mr{अहवाल}}, \emph{ahvāl}.) A subject? (\textbf{\mr{विषय}}, \emph{viṣay}.) Chalk? (\textbf{\mr{खडू}}, \emph{khaḍū}.) Marks; a quality? (\textbf{\mr{गुण}}, \emph{guṇ}.) A cradle? (\textbf{\mr{पाळणा}}, \emph{pāḷṇā}.) A career? (\textbf{\mr{कारकीर्द}}, \emph{kārkīrda}.) A monthly magazine? (\textbf{\mr{मासिक}}, \emph{māsik}.) A dictionary? (\textbf{\mr{शब्दकोश}}, \emph{śabdakoś}.) A university? (\textbf{\mr{विद्यापीठ}}, \emph{vidyāpīṭh}.) A mistake? (\textbf{\mr{चूक}}, \emph{cūk}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
